test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: **The main theme of the given passage is:**

options.text: slow population growth in India and China

solution:
The correct answer is: **China’s declining population**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The main theme of a passage refers to the central idea or the overarching message that the author is trying to convey through the text.
 
• The main theme of the passage is **China's declining population. **Because,
 
 
• Although the passage talks about both China and India, **it mainly focuses on China.**
 
• The passage describes the slow growth of China for some years and finally the decline in population last year.
 
• It also describes the bad economic condition as an effect of slow population growth.
 
• So it is clear that the main theme of this passage is about China.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**: China's worsening economic growth is not the main theme of the passage, although it may be indirectly related to China's declining population.
 
• **Option 2**: Slow population growth in India and China is not the main theme of the passage, although there are some references to India it mainly concentrates on China.
 
• **Option 3**: India's working-age population is not the main theme of the passage, although it may be mentioned in passing as a comparison to China's aging population.
